summary: Across four sessions, the work moved through a changing number of episodes and turns. The first session spanned thirteen episodes across fifty-six turns, with verification taking up three episodes and eighteen turns, the heaviest turn count of any code in that session. The second session spanned sixteen episodes across forty-eight turns, with implementation taking up six episodes and fourteen turns, becoming the most frequent code in that session. The third session spanned ten episodes across sixty turns, with exploration taking up two episodes and ten turns. The fourth session spanned six episodes across fifty turns, with verification taking up two episodes and eleven turns and planning taking up one episode and eight turns, showing a narrower spread of episodes than earlier sessions while turn counts stayed close to fifty.
